title: ArgOS conditions snapshot
description: GENERATED by tools/gen_snapshot_schema.py from config/signals.yaml; do not edit. One snapshot per tick (tick n at t_ship_s n): what the state estimator hands the core. Every field carries value, source, age_s, confidence and stale. No wall-clock time, so a replay reproduces it exactly. Contract: docs/STATE_ESTIMATION.md.

variant.description: the starting state (signals.yaml baselines.<scenario>.variants, or default)

tick.description: snapshot counter; tick n is at t_ship_s = n

t_ship_s.description: ship seconds since minute 0 (ARCHITECTURE contract 4 calls it t_s)

constants.description: run constants stated by the scenario (signals.yaml run_constants)

chw_flow_pct.description: % of nominal; plant; 1 Hz; feed chw

notes.description: free text for fixtures; never read by the core

transition.description: a change under way (an A.6 transition, a genset restart); the value moves linearly for numbers, enums keep the old value until the end tick

requests_value.description: open bridge confirmation requests, one per decision that asked

capacity_value.description: capacity of a live class; committed and free are ledger lines (ledger_rules)

zero_by_rule.description: 0 by rule (acoustic down, silence): demand is buffered

start.description: a run's starting state (signals.yaml baselines): raw signal name (Gx.key for guests) to its value at tick 0

event.description: an event the simulator applied at this tick (timeline or laptop); signals.yaml events

age_s.description: ship seconds since the reading (t_ship_s - t_s); 0 for a derived field; null before the first reading

stale.description: the signal's feed has gone quiet (feeds); a derived field only through a substituted input

since_t_s.description: ship time the value last changed

reported_t_s.description: for a crew answer: when it was given; expiry counts from here

by.description: effect fields only: the guests whose running activity sets this value

substituted.description: the conservative fallback in use, for the decision sentence

raw_event_t_s.description: the first tick any vote for this subject was true
